node.title: HGE4 ambient-prime exact-level contraction
node.closure: proof plus exact official-row arithmetic verifier
node.statement: For an official ambient order n=2^s, exact ratio level m=2^r|n, and split prime p>=n^2, the coupled norm/Vandermonde/swap gate deletes every lower-quarter width satisfying n^(2 floor(h/2)) >= (4h-floor((h-1)/2)-2)^(m/4). In particular, with c(n,m)=2 ceil(mr/(8s)), E_h^prim(m,p)=0 for max(4,c(n,m))<=h<m/3. Thus every proper exact level contracts below its local quarter frontier while the top level also gains parity-sensitive exact deletions. The closed-form cutoff alone deletes 55,050,457,488 additional (n,m,h) cells. This is a width exclusion, not a surviving-orbit estimate or an HGE4 closure.
